historical_primary.read_mode: Direct visual inspection original first-edition page image
historical_primary.verbatim_short_part1: his Dispositor behold him with some aspect
historical_primary.verbatim_short_part3: have recourse to that Planet who forcibly aspects Luna and Mercury with a partill aspect

external_source_qualification.read_mode: Modern transcription and nonprimary supplementary witness, not normative in conflict with directly examined first printing
external_source_qualification.finding: Available later reproductions repeat the same disputed sentence, but do not unambiguously adjudicate what Lilly meant when other planets aspect the ASC lord without the dispositor aspecting it.

historical_claims.meaning: For a no-first-body and no Moon/Mercury joining fallback, the ASC lord is assigned manners only conditional on its DISPOSITOR beholding it by some aspect.

The later rule says if no planet aspects 'him', where the antecedent appears to be the ASC lord. It might require no planetary aspect at all, or refer back to the dispositor's aspect. Does not explicitly resolve third case of OTHER planetary aspect with no dispositor aspect.
If the ASC lord is its own domicile dispositor, it cannot physically aspect itself; do not count self-contacts as positive evidence, and preserve historical uncertainty.
All OTHER six classical planets tested for aspects to ASC lord. Two methods for aspect rays matched to earlier dispositor-geometry variants; separately add moiety-qualified bodily conjunction.
A chart with OTHER planetary aspects to ASC lord but absent required dispositing aspect is classified SX unresolved under broad literal gate. Not a newly source-assigned manners significator.

source_geometry_variants.bodily_conjunction_interpretation: All other classical planets near ASC lord using Lilly original moieties. Body-relative ecliptic latitudes are NOT independently used here; this is a historical-rule sensitivity not a certified Ptolemy I.24 bodily contact.

six_stage_labels.S1: Planet in first/ascending/ intercepted place as variant defines
six_stage_labels.S3: ASC lord's own dispositor actually beholds it
six_stage_labels.SX: Other planets aspect ASC lord, but its dispositor does not; source does not specify significator
six_stage_labels.S4: No planet aspects ASC lord, and candidate for 'forcible partile' to Moon or Mercury
six_stage_labels.S5: No planet aspect ASC lord, and no counted partile; essential dignities/fixed stars unresolved
